note: Generated by reflection over the pinned oracle. The lexer emits a single TokenKind.Annotation for every one of these, so the name lives in the token's text and no TokenKind digest can see it change. This is a coverage vocabulary, never a validity check: the Annotation token is open, because Java interop annotations lex identically and upstream models them with Annotation.Error. Text is read from toString, not from the class name, because TailRecursive renders as @Tailrec.
